configuration_schema.purpose: Machine-readable separation of a commercial product from its installable physical variants and operating configurations.

hard_constraint_sources: exact rows of official performance tables
selection_contract.interpolation_policy: Values between official table rows may be calculated by the application, but must be marked derived and must not be represented as manufacturer-exact.
selection_contract.catalog_availability_policy: Automatic BOM may use only a physical variant marked this_product, this_bundle, included_nozzle_tree, included_nozzle_rack, or this_nozzle_set.
selection_contract.legacy_calculation_ready_policy: Do not use quality.calculation_ready to choose an emitter configuration; use design_selection.automatic_layout_eligible plus the selected configuration option.

geometry_rules: A continuous arc range confirms that any angle inside the closed interval is mechanically achievable.
A fixed 360 degree nozzle is a separate physical variant unless the rotor mechanism explicitly supports part and full circle in one model.
A radius range alone does not supply an exact flow; exact hydraulic values come from official table rows.
Manufacturer radius-reduction limits describe geometry; flow after reduction is not exact unless separately tabulated.
Strip nozzles use width and length, not a circular radius.
A spray body without a nozzle is not a water-emitter configuration.

confidence_levels.manufacturer_verified: Direct official manufacturer range or exact table row.
confidence_levels.derived_by_application_not_manufacturer_: Calculated or interpolated by the application from official data.
confidence_levels.retailer_variant_values_present_exact_ma: Retailer values exist, but the precise factory variant is not yet proven.
confidence_levels.blocked: Must not be used for automatic selection.
